materials: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: usable 2D dungeon terrain MATERIAL atlas for a flat illustrated torso-pawn game. Reference images are the actual in-game character pawns: adopt their CLEAN SMOOTH DARK OUTLINES, LARGE FLAT SOLID COLOUR SHAPES and ONLY TWO-TONE CEL SHADING. NOT pixel art. NOT textured painting. NOT photorealism. Absolutely no speckling, dithering, grain, grunge detail, gradients, bevel rendering or tiny cracks. Generate one square 4x4 exact equal-cell material atlas. All cells opaque and filled edge-to-edge, no margins, labels, separating grid or outer frame. Low contrast muted charcoal warm-grey stone with broad geometric slabs, black-grey joints, softly irregular straight edges. This is a subdued dark dungeon, not bright cheerful cartoon. Orthographic ground viewed from above. Row1: four closely matching floor variants of large grey rectangular flagstones with minimal simple joints and at most one broad crack. Row2 col1: FRONT WALL MATERIAL, strict horizontal coping band top25%, three horizontal courses of large rectangular charcoal masonry blocks below, directly front-facing, no corner or endcap. Row2 col2: TOP WALL MATERIAL, large dark grey rectangular blocks viewed straight down, no facade or perspective. Row2 col3: worn brown wood planks top-down, minimal straight black joints. Row2 col4: dark metal floor plates top-down. Row3: quiet dark desaturated blue water; same water with two simple pale ripple strokes; muted brown mud; subdued moss between grey slabs. Row4: small flat angular stone rubble ground texture; packed dark earth with two broad stones; blackened grey slabs with a few flat amber embers; slightly damp grey flagstones. Different tiles must be readable but restrained, floor quieter than character silhouettes. Same simple graphic vocabulary as supplied flat character sprites. No characters or objects included. Walls will be assembled procedurally; provide material samples only, no isometric room, no wall scene. Deliberately minimalist clean 2D game art.
props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent prop atlas for the supplied flat torso-pawn dark dungeon game. ONE square 4x4 equal-cell sprite atlas, 16 isolated objects. Match reference characters EXACT graphic language: smooth dark charcoal bold outlines, large simple flat colour fills, maximum two-tone cel shading, extremely minimal details. NOT pixel art, NOT detailed gritty rendering, NOT gradients or dither, NOT realistic texture. Slightly elevated orthographic top-down with small front faces, no isometric diamonds. Muted charcoal warm-grey stone, subdued brown wood and leather, dull iron; flames warm orange and cream with just two flat nested shapes. REAL TRANSPARENT background outside every prop and through openings; no floor, black background, glow, vignette, painted checkerboard, cast ground shadow, text, grids, labels. Every prop fits wholly inside its own cell with at least12% transparent margin and a centred bottom baseline at82% cell height. Row1: broken square stone pillar stump; pile of three angular grey rocks; closed brown wooden crate with simple X brace; small upright wooden barrel. Row2: lit iron wall torch with simple orange flame and no halo; same torch unlit; low circular lit brazier; campfire with three brown logs and simple orange flame. Row3: locked chest with simple brass latch; small dirt mound with partly buried slab; closed low stone sarcophagus; low stone altar. Row4: sealed glowing pale cyan relic on low square pedestal; simple flat iron portcullis doorway prop; small bone pile; wooden barricade of two crossed planks. No characters. All objects match the simple actual character references, quiet restrained dark fantasy. Game-ready cutout sprites, no glossy 3D, no pixelated edge effect.
